Rebuild and review actual media for all unaccepted actions, including endpoints, contacts, crossings and loop seams, then test target AIRI playback.

Source pose review, manual actual-frame samples, and all-frame automatic measurements are separate.
Historical sampled media are excluded from current visual coverage when SHA differs.
Fixed-master samples preserve equipment but do not imply full 120-action articulation.
